In detail

This municipalità holds Catania Centrale and piazza Papa Giovanni XXIII, one of the six areas in the Prefettura's zone rosse ordinance, which cited illegal parking attendants and predatory crime around the station. It also holds Ognina, the seafront and its summer nightlife, which is a different world a kilometre away. Arriving by train, the caution is the forecourt and the underpasses, not the district.
